title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
hook_text: TechCrunch mapped text message AI agents
script:
TechCrunch published a guide on October twenty fourth to AI agents living in text messages.
These assistants skip standalone apps to operate inside standard chat threads.
They manage family schedules, travel planning, and work workflows directly from your phone.
Users text them like real contacts to fetch data and trigger tasks.
Would you text an AI to manage your day?
